headline: Mostly flat with W/WSW becoming NW/WNW winds.
body:
Dawn to Midday: Not really any rideable surf expected. Semi-clean early becoming a little cleaner by midday.
Afternoon Outlook: Cleaner minimal surf the remainder of the day.

headline: Continued meager surf with SSW/SW winds.
body:
Dawn to Midday: No rideable surf expected. SSW/SW winds add some texture.
Afternoon Outlook: More minimal surf with SSW/SW winds.

headline: Continued meager surf early with gentle E/SE winds. Tiny uptick in S/SE swell possible before dark.
body:
Dawn to Midday: No rideable surf expected. Light onshore E/SE winds add some texture.
Afternoon Outlook: More minimal surf with onshore winds and textured conditions expected most of the afternoon. Some tiny forerunners of rising S/SE swell to start spreading in before dark, but right now the timing is pretty close to sunset and conditions won't be favorable with onshore E winds.

headline: Increasing SE swell from low pressure. Onshore winds may be doable early.
body:
Dawn to Midday: Low pressure shifting up the East Coast sets up increasing SE swell. Fun zone thigh-waist+ high surf showing through midday. Currently expecting ENE winds, but that are not too strong through lunch or so, allowing for doable conditions. 
Afternoon Outlook: Later in the day, building onshore E/ENE winds are still light enough for doable surf and the surf keeps building into the chest+ high range. Not great though, so I would probably wait till Friday.
